sentences.text: The documents do not state the foreclosure charge for your car loans.

For cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB, and the charge must be disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement.
No evidence item provides the approved policy for car loans or a car-loan-specific foreclosure charge.
